ARCLUME STUDIO / THE DETAILS

Privacy policy

A clear explanation of what happens to your information on this website.

Updated September 10, 2026

Private preview · Draft for business review. Legal business details and the contact address must be confirmed before public launch.

Who this notice is about

This notice describes the Arclume Studio website. The legal business identity, operating location and privacy contact are awaiting confirmation in this private preview.

Your project brief

The current “Save brief to my device” form lets you enter a name, email address, business or website, service of interest and project idea. Only the idea is required in this draft mode. The website processes these answers in your browser to create a text file you can download. It does not submit the answers to Arclume, save them in a studio database or add them to a mailing list.

The page does not deliberately save your answers in browser storage. Your browser may retain form entries through its own autofill or session features. Downloaded copies remain on your device until you remove them.

If email contact is enabled

If the button says “Continue to email,” it opens your email application with the information you entered. You must send that email yourself. Your email provider then processes the message under its own terms, and Arclume receives the information you send. It would be used to understand and respond to your inquiry, discuss a proposal and manage related correspondence. Sending an inquiry does not subscribe you to marketing emails.

Do not include passwords, payment card information or sensitive personal information in a project brief.

Website delivery and technical information

The hosting service may process technical information such as your IP address, browser information and request logs to deliver and protect the website. Access to this private preview may also require the hosting platform’s sign-in. Those platform processes are separate from the project brief.

Arclume’s page code does not currently include advertising pixels, analytics tools, embedded social feeds or remote fonts. Images, scripts and styles are served with the site. Read the cookie notice for details.

Other websites

When active social profile links are added, following one will take you to another provider. Its privacy practices apply to your visit there. A “Coming soon” label is not an active link.

Retention, access and correction

Arclume does not receive or retain locally downloaded briefs. You control the downloaded file. A retention schedule and a request process for any future received inquiries must be confirmed before direct submissions are enabled. Where applicable law provides rights to access, correct or request deletion of information held by the business, those requests should be directed to the verified privacy contact.

Security

The hosted website uses HTTPS. The current brief form does not transmit your answers to a server. No online service or device can be guaranteed completely secure; protect downloaded briefs and use trusted email and devices when sharing them.

Updates and contact

This notice will be updated when contact handling, service providers, analytics or other data practices change.

The studio’s contact address is being finalized for this private preview. A verified address for privacy requests and other inquiries will be published before the site opens to the public.
